title: Report any month from a row layout
objective: Look up sales and target for three report months across a row, then calculate variance and status.
instructions: The report months are in B5:D5. In B6:D6 use XLOOKUP to find each month in the headings B1:G1 and return the sales from B2:G2. In B7:D7 return the target from B3:G3. In B8:D8 work out variance as sales minus target. In B9:D9 use IF to show the text "On target" when the variance is zero or more, otherwise "Below target". Use mixed references so the same formula works when copied across.
hints: The months are across row 1, so the lookup range is B1:G1 and the return range is a row too: B2:G2 for sales and B3:G3 for target.
For B6 start with =XLOOKUP(B5,$B$1:$G$1,$B$2:$G$2). Only the month cell should move when you copy across.
Use B$5 (with the $ before the 5) so the month always comes from row 5. Use $ signs on the whole table ranges.
Variance is B6-B7. For the status, test the variance: =IF(B8>=0,"On target","Below target").
